probe_mount.verdict: Stiffness is not the limit for any option (sub-um deflection, kHz modes); the anchor joint (2 x ~M2 into unknown toolhead tabs) and thermal growth of the printed path are. The 785004 anchor is the default because it is proven in service at today's pin position; PA-CF + closed section cut thermal drift ~40 % vs a PLA/PETG 785004. The heatsink option halves the path but is blocked by the LiDAR body box until M6.

duct.note: rigid duct; posts and duct bending ignored (both lower it). Target > 2 x 77.6 Hz. Tabs spread in Z (T_3) turn pitch into push-pull on the tab joints, which is far stiffer than arm torsion.
